responsibility: This header defines the abstract `Linemap` interface used by the Rust frontend to create, query, and stringify source locations independently of the concrete backend. It specifies file/line lifecycle methods, conversion from columns to `Location`, special predeclared and unknown locations, and singleton-based static convenience accessors, so lexer, parser, diagnostics, and later passes can use location services through a stable backend-neutral API.
same_name_distinction: Defines the backend-neutral `Linemap` interface and singleton/static accessors that frontend code uses, but not the GCC line-table behavior itself. That concrete behavior, plus `RichLocation` method bodies and `rust_get_linemap`, lives in `rust-linemap.cc`.
